cardputer‑puzzles

All 40 of Simon Tatham's puzzles on the M5Stack Cardputer ADV. Flash one .bin and play offline.

Source on GitHub Releases Upstream collection

Install

Plug the Cardputer into this computer over USB‑C and press the button. The whole firmware is written from your browser - no PlatformIO, no esptool, no driver install.

This browser can't talk to serial devices. Use Chrome or Edge on desktop, or flash manually with the commands below. Serial access needs a secure (https) page. Open this site over https.

Desktop Chrome or Edge only (Web Serial). Version -. The write skips the nvs partition and stops far short of the save-file partition, so upgrading keeps your in-progress games. If the device isn't listed in the port picker, hold G0 while plugging it in.

Flash manually instead

Download cardputer-puzzles-vX.Y-merged.bin from the latest release and write it at offset 0x0:

esptool --chip esp32s3 write-flash 0x0 cardputer-puzzles-vX.Y-merged.bin

That single-command form erases the nvs partition in the gap it spans. To keep an existing device's settings, write the two halves around it:

esptool --chip esp32s3 write-flash 0x0 firmware-0x0.bin 0xe000 firmware-0xe000.bin

Both split parts are served from this page (0x0, 0xe000) and are the same bytes as the merged image.

Running an SD-card launcher such as the M5Stack Launcher? Take the -app.bin asset instead. It keeps the device's own partition table, so saved games persist only if that table has a spiffs partition.

Every game keeps its own board across a power‑off, with preset and custom sizes, an in‑menu rules viewer, and an error path that returns to the menu instead of hanging.

Controls

Every plain key goes to the puzzle, so games that use letters (Map's l, Solo's hex digits) work as they do upstream. Frontend commands live on Ctrl, Tab and `.

; . , /Move cursor (up / down / left / right)
EnterSelect - the cursor cell, or a click at the crosshair in pointer mode
SpaceSelect2 / mark (flag, pencil, ...)
digits, letters, ⌫Per-game input
Ctrl+Z / YUndo / redo
Ctrl+N / RNew game / restart
TabMenu in a game (size, new, restart, solve, pointer, zoom, pan, rules); help on the game list
Ctrl+PToggle the IMU tilt pointer
Ctrl+SpaceRecenter the tilt pointer on your current hold
Ctrl+LToggle 2× zoom; Ctrl+;.,/ pans
`Back, to the game list or out of a menu

Drag games - Map, Pegs, Signpost, Guess and Untangle - split the drag across two presses in pointer mode, because the crosshair can't hold a button: Enter picks up, tilt to aim, Enter drops. The key that picked it up is the key that drops it; the other key cancels.

Hardware

Built and tested on the M5Stack Cardputer ADV (ESP32‑S3 Stamp‑S3A, 8 MB flash, no PSRAM, 240×135 display). It should run on the original Cardputer too - same board family and panel, and M5Unified picks the keyboard driver at runtime - but that's untested; the tilt pointer needs the IMU the ADV added, so it stays off there. If you try it, open an issue saying what the Fn keys do.

Build it yourself

git clone --recurse-submodules https://github.com/chongjiazhen/cardputer-puzzles
cd cardputer-puzzles
pio run -e puzzles -t upload

Game logic lives in upstream/, a git submodule pinned unmodified. Only the Cardputer frontend (src/puzzles/, lib/) is original to this project.
